A [[human]]<ref name="Human" /> '''individual''' was a [[First Order TIE fighter pilot|pilot]] for the [[First Order]].<ref name="Rebuilding the Resistance" /> In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="34 ABY" /> they served as a member of a [[Unidentified First Order TIE squadron|squadron]] patrolling a [[Blockade of Dantooine|blockade]] of the [[planet]] [[Dantooine]] in a [[TIE/fo space superiority fighter]]. When the [[Resistance]]-affiliated [[Jade Squadron]], accompanied by three [[pilot]]s of the [[Trantor-class supertanker fuel depot|station]] ''[[Colossus]]''{{'s}} [[Ace Squadron]]—[[Torra Doza]], [[Hype Fazon]], and [[Kazuda Xiono]]—attempted to bypass the [[blockade]] and escort [[Resistance shuttle|shuttles]] of recruits for the Resistance off-world, the [[TIE series|TIE]] pilot and their squadmates [[Starfighter combat|engaged]] the [[Resistance pilot]]s.<ref name="Rebuilding the Resistance" />

As the makeshift [[squadron]] destroyed the rest of their company, the pilot attempted to contact [[Commander]] [[Pyre]], requesting backup. Xiono, piloting the ''[[Fireball]]'', shot and destroyed the pilot's [[starfighter]], [[Death|killing]] them. Though [[Jade Leader]] [[Venisa Doza]]'s [[Astromech droid|droid]] [[Torch]] [[Jammer|jammed]] the squadron's [[comm unit]]s, Pyre directed the [[Resurgent-class Star Destroyer|''Resurgent''-class Star Destroyer]]<ref name="Rebuilding the Resistance" /> ''[[Thunderer]]''{{'s}}<ref name="Battles">''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]''</ref> course to Dantooine due to the squadron's communications ceasing. The pilot wore the standard [[Color|black]] [[First Order TIE pilot flight suit|uniform]] of First Order pilots.<ref name="Rebuilding the Resistance" />

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot first appeared in "[[Rebuilding the Resistance]],"<ref name="Rebuilding the Resistance" /> the seventeenth episode of the [[Star Wars Resistance Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', which aired on [[January 19]], [[2020]].<ref name="Disney release">{{DisneyPress|wdtv=1|url=disneychannel/shows/star-wars-resistance/episodes|text=Star Wars Resistance}}</ref> Their voice actor was uncredited in the episode.<ref name="Rebuilding the Resistance" />
